reviews.title: Tricking customers
reviews.text:
Chewy has become or maybe always has like other corporations that think that the best way to do business with customers is to trick them.  Deceptive discounts that aren’t actually there and misleading prompts to make an order a “subscription”.
We will file a complaint with the better business board and with our attorney general. 

Please apologize for this behavior and please stop  the deceptions.

reviews.title: Not good
reviews.text:
I remember when Chewy was one of those stand out companies you could trust. My dogs are my babies and I spend thousands per year at Chewy. Too bad theyre not who they used to be - or at least CLAIMED to be. First, they’re trumpstein
supporters. Enough said. Second, they have shady business practices where they price gouge customers over what the REAL prices are. I’ll just buy straight from each individual company from now on. Also, FDT.

reviews.title: Chewy gave in to right wing cancel culture
reviews.text: Cannot believe Chewy decided the smartest thing to do was to condemn the I’ve Had It ladies over laughing at a Kirk joke. Insane behavior, especially now post-midterms. No one’s forcing you! Who cleared that decision?? I’m sick and tired of giving my money to spineless corporations that are actively contributing to the rot of cultural conservatism. It’ll be difficult but I’ll be looking to find alternatives for my autoship orders nonetheless. I’ll start at Costco and local pet stores. Unbelievable.
